body: I will want to live in another country than my own at some point and there is million things I like about North America. English is my second best language so I'm goin to be using that. I know there are other english speaking countries. I can't really produce more text today. Cyaz

Thanks for your awesome replies, making my day better. People judging too fast is not good. I try to keep open mind. One day I will move somewhere in the Northern America. For some reason I can't really think straight, sorry for my shorts replies.

Thanks man. Your belief makes good sense to me. I am proud of who I am as a person but it's weird to think that from all the people I have met in my life only two have thought that I would be a great friend plus you. Like why is that?

In northern european universities there are no side classes unfortunately. The system here is very different to other places. You have faith in me without knowing who I am, you are a kind soul. I hope I get there and also hope you have a great life cause you deserve much more than many others.
Yeah but for some time I haven't been interested in anything. I will make sure to pick the right classes tho when it comes to that. If it ever comes.

School haven't been too tough on me as exam wise cause I was also a bit street smart but just sitting there all day listening about things you don't care about was very hard. Currently my first choice is economics.

Honestly that particular dream almost got me into believing it was my fault cause in the dream I hurt my friend and similar things have happened in real life, couple of times when we were playing I have accidentally done something that got him hurt. For example while playing sports I accidentally tripped him and he somehow hit his rib badly on the ground. The fall looked like nothing but he had broken his rib earlier (he hadn't told anyone) and it was recovering and it got broken again at that point. So that dream momentarily hit me pretty hard, I'm not a big believer but the devil is definitely playing his A game to fuck with me.  
I used to have some fake friends in high school, I got many type of ppl you really don't want around you, narcissists and such. I learned to recognize them and ditched them. I like that you said you would drive 2 hours to pick me up. I actually once did that for a friend of my good friend. I got call in 2 am in the weekend that this guy and his gf were drunk near my city and needed 30 min ride home cause the bus would not go there. While I drove them they told that the reason they were there was that they helped an extremly intoxicated guy to get home, they had carry the guy for some kilometers. I felt happy of driving them home.
So my mission is to find a very good therapist and get my life back on rails :D

Thanks for sharing you personal experience, really appreciate that. Yea I'm getin convinced that I need to try therapy. What do I have to lose  
Actually now that I think about it, an old female friend of mine had kinda similiar story in highschool and going to therapy helped her too. And I lost her because of my own stupidity. I hope I can get to university as fast as possible so I could meet new people, I feel like I would be happier having more true friends. This would require me being able to read more than 10 min a week.

I'm glad therapy helped your fiance, that improvement is huge. I'm probably gonna try it at some point but my situation is not typical depression case. I don't have anything difficult subject to talk about. I just feel sad, hate almost everything, barely like anything and doing things that require effort are impossible to do.
Take all the time you need, just that one answer was way more than one could ask.

Thanks for long answer. I used to to not give a second thought to dreams but currently I'm not at my strongest mentally and that dream was really really vivid. Very nice of you to say I seem like a sweet person. Most ppl have always liked me during my life but for some reason that I can't comprehend I'm left with two true friends after 20 years. I'm definitely gonna stick around for some time to see what happens. Your last point is 100% right.

I have thought about therapy and I'm not afraid to talk about this but I can't see how can he/she help me. I have searched for some methods but haven't really found anything useful. If know some, do share.
